verdict.rationale: Ollama itself provides management of downloaded models: a REST API for managing models, with community users confirming pull/rm workflows and praising its model management. The evidence says nothing about saved prompts or per-model configurations, nor about a single unified place to manage all three. missing for 10: saved prompt management, per-model configuration management, a unified single-place management UI or workflow, first-party docs detailing model management.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place

citations.quote: Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
One 'ollama pull' and it's available. Underwhelming? 'ollama rm'.
llama.cpp does almost everything ollama does better except model management.
